scan.status_preview: Scan status is not available in the browser preview / standalone window

Scanning pauses while settings or the area picker is open or the game is not in the foreground; Runeshape also pauses while the price panel is open. Each scan captures the screen, so raise the interval (e.g. 1500 ms) if CPU usage is too high.

page_note.map_mods: Tick the modifiers you want and paste the string into the stash search bar. The fragments avoid every other modifier on this list, and the modifier names, tiers, tags, reminder text and map names the game also searches.
page_note.logbook_mods: Tick the logbook modifiers you want. The fragments avoid every other modifier on this list, and the modifier names, tiers, reminder text and logbook names the game also searches.
page_note.waystone_mods: Tick the modifiers you want and paste the string into the stash search bar. The no-false-hit guarantee only covers the other modifiers on this list.
page_note.tablet_mods: All eight tablet types share one list, grouped by tablet. The "Any" group can roll on every tablet; Irradiated tablets only roll that group. The no-false-hit guarantee only covers the other modifiers on this list.
page_note.relic_mods: Relic modifiers for the Trial of the Sekhemas. The no-false-hit guarantee only covers this list.
page_note.expedition_relic_mods: Expedition relic upsides and downsides. The no-false-hit guarantee only covers this list.
page_note.vendor_items: Links, socket colours, item level, quality, corrupted and influence. Each tick is its own condition (all must hold). The socket rows assume the zh client shows R-G-B untranslated (untested).
page_note.vendor_items_poe2: Item level, quality, corrupted and gem level. Each tick is its own condition (all must hold).
page_note.item_mod_values: PoE1 item modifier values (explicit, implicit, crafted, fractured). Each tick is its own condition (all must hold). Templates come from stats.ndjson; each fragment is the number plus the whole modifier line (shortened word by word only when too long), unique among all modifier templates.
page_note.item_mod_values_poe2: PoE2 item modifier values (explicit, implicit, crafted, fractured). Each tick is its own condition (all must hold). Templates come from stats.ndjson; each fragment is the number plus the whole modifier line (shortened word by word only when too long), unique among all modifier templates.

regex.custom_unverified: Custom text is not verified and may match other items.
regex.algo_hint: Each tick is its own condition (all must hold). Editing a value ticks the row.
regex.imv_loading: Loading item modifiers (the first visit reads the modifier table, about a second)…
regex.imv_search_ph: Search modifiers (Chinese or English, space-separated words)
regex.imv_more: {n} more match. Type more words or pick a category to narrow it down.
regex.imv_note: Only modifiers with exactly one number are listed (multi-value ones such as "Adds # to # Fire Damage" are not). Whole numbers only: decimal modifiers are left out, and negative values (e.g. "-5% to Fire Resistance") count as positive under ≥. Some fragments are anchored to the start / end of the line to keep longer modifiers with the same words out.
regex.imv_hint: Each tick is its own condition (all must hold). Editing a value ticks the row. The ≤ / range upper bound is at most 999; ≥ has no upper bound. Each fragment is the whole modifier line by default, shortened word by word only when too long, and never matches another modifier.
regex.section_hint: Values on property lines such as tier, quantity and rarity. Each tick is its own condition (all must hold) and joins the modifiers below in one string. Editing a value ticks the row. Patterns follow the community format "Label: +N%" (half- or full-width colon, optional +; only the whole number right after the colon is matched, never across lines); tier matches the name "(Tier N)"; rarity matches the "Rarity: Rare" line.
